Paying attention and showing it. The exercises focus on staying with a conversation and letting the other person feel heard, which is more about focus and habits than hearing.

A printable PDF you can fill in on screen or print at home. It opens on a computer, tablet, or phone.

Can I just buy this one?

Yes. Every Power Skill workbook is $15 on its own. The $79 bundle is the lower-cost way to get all nine.

Is this the same as the free workbook?

No. The free Adulting Like A Champ workbook is the front door. This goes deeper on one Power Skill.

Can I get a refund?

You are fully protected by our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee. If you and your learner aren’t satisfied within 30 days of purchase, just let us know and we’ll send a prompt refund. No refunds are issued beyond this 30-day period.

It works on a computer, tablet, or phone. Download it once and use it wherever you like.

WHY ACTIVE LISTENING IS HARD

Listening looks easy, but it’s a lot at once: holding your own thoughts, reading tone and body language, and resisting the urge to jump in. When your mind moves fast, that’s genuinely hard, and it can leave you a step behind or a little misunderstood.

Practice waiting before you jump in, so you stop finishing other people’s sentences.

Build your focus stamina, so you can stay with longer conversations.

High-Stakes Listening
Stay calm and tuned in during conflict, so a tough talk doesn’t throw you off.

Look back at what’s changed and what you’re proud of, and notice how far you’ve come.

You’re on Your Way
Choose your next move and one small step to keep practicing, in real life or your next Power Skill.
